parent_objective: implement no-training concentration-aware split and weight plan
blocked_by: M1305 requires a no-training plan builder before any weighted update
supersedes: direct weighted trainable-scope repeat without plan audit

public_gates: M1306 must preserve actor input contract
M1306 must not use private holdout
M1306 must output balanced split rows
M1306 must output group weight rows
M1306 must prove no pair_id-specific weights are used

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: builds a no-training balanced split and weight plan for the M1304 concentration failure
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: diagnostic infrastructure only; no promotion, private-holdout, PPO, closed-loop, paper-level, high-fidelity, or strong self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if plan uses pair-specific weights
stop if folds are not pair-disjoint
stop if implementation starts training or PPO
fallback_plan: if the plan is admissible, route to bounded weighted repeat design or implementation
if the corpus cannot be balanced, route to source corpus expansion
if public-row overfit risk is too high, route to branch synthesis
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: ninth milestone in trainable-scope escalation branch

admission_evidence: M1305 designs split and weight refresh before training
M1304 failure concentration is source-family/probe-template, not pair singleton
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1306 builds a fixed-current diagnostic plan only; it does not evaluate closed-loop history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: preserve correct-history versus wrong-history diagnostic rows
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1304 fixed-current source-history eval group rows.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If the plan cannot be balanced without pair-specific weights, keep PPO blocked and route to corpus expansion or branch synthesis.
allowed_claims: no strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, high-fidelity validation, real-vehicle, paper-result, or closed-loop driver claim

hypothesis: A no-training plan builder can produce pair-disjoint balanced folds and capped group weights that address M1304 source-family/probe-template concentration without pair-specific overfit.
success_criteria: no training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, threshold relaxation, or actor-input expansion occurs
decision_rule: M1306 passes if it creates an admissible pair-disjoint concentration-aware split and capped group-weight plan without training, PPO, promotion, private holdout use, threshold relaxation, pair-specific weights, or actor-input expansion.
